# @doc-preview/themes

Shared CSS for Doc Preview viewers — layout, PDF toolbar, DOCX body, image stage, annotation overlays, split view, modals, and Enterprise chrome. Used by all framework adapters.

**Current release: 1.2.0** — See [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md).

**Repository:** [github.com/rajkishorsahu89/doc-preview](https://github.com/rajkishorsahu89/doc-preview)

**Demo:** [docpreview.stackkitlabs.com](https://docpreview.stackkitlabs.com/) — [tool](https://docpreview.stackkitlabs.com/tool) · [guide](https://docpreview.stackkitlabs.com/guide)

**Keywords:** `doc-preview` `css` `theme` `document-viewer`

## Install

```bash
npm install @doc-preview/themes
```

Install alongside any `@doc-preview/*` adapter (`react`, `angular`, `js`).

## Supported file types

Themes style the viewer for every format Doc Preview renders — PDF, DOCX, CSV/XLSX tables, PPTX/ODP decks, images, HTML, and media. Extension list: [`@doc-preview/core` README](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@doc-preview/core#supported-file-types-community--built-into-core) and [`@doc-preview/office` README](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@doc-preview/office#supported-file-types).

## Usage

**CSS import (recommended):**

```css
@import "@doc-preview/themes/doc-preview.css";
```

**Angular `angular.json`:**

```json
"styles": ["node_modules/@doc-preview/themes/doc-preview.css"]
```

**React / Vite:**

```ts
import "@doc-preview/themes/doc-preview.css";
```

## Package exports

| Import | File |
| --- | --- |
| `@doc-preview/themes` | `doc-preview.css` |
| `@doc-preview/themes/doc-preview.css` | `doc-preview.css` |

## Customization

Override CSS variables on the preview root (`#doc-preview-root` or `.dp-root`) for brand colors, borders, and spacing. See the monorepo docs **Architecture** guide for token names.
